title: Final Answer 1
description: Essential Criteria: The probability of finding He+ in the ground state must be correctly calculated as 512/729.

title: Final Answer 2
description: Essential Criteria: The probability of finding He+ in the 2s state must be correctly calculated as 1/4.

title: Final Answer 3
description: Essential Criteria: The probability of finding He+ in the 2p state must be correctly calculated as 0.

title: Correct Integrals
description: Important Criteria: The integrals used to calculate the coefficients a1, a2, and a3 must be set up correctly.

title: Normalization Check
description: Optional Criteria: A check for the normalization of the wave functions involved in the calculations is beneficial.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in the coefficients a2 and a3.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
